title: Shared review for shopping-list and meal-plan follow-up tweaks
description: Perform the final integrated review of implementation, tests, and documentation with attention to UI regressions, file-operation safety, duplicate handling, and navigation refresh behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Review confirms all five scoped tweaks match the specification and do not introduce CookbookCore schema changes.
Review checks security-scoped file access patterns around rename operations.
Review checks duplicate-name handling, error surfacing, and stale-URL/navigation behavior for both rename flows.
Review checks the edit-item flow for correct same-aisle vs aisle-change mutation behavior and persistence.
Review confirms shared tests and documentation are complete enough for the shipped scope.
